name: Cooperative Intelligence in Language Model Agents
description: The task is to develop language model (LM) agents capable of cooperative intelligence in mixed-motive social dilemma scenarios using the Concordia framework. These agents must demonstrate skills such as promise-keeping, negotiation, reciprocity, and compromise in text-mediated environments.

cr:input.name: Concordia Scenarios
cr:input.description: A set of mixed-motive social dilemma scenarios where LM agents interact in text-mediated environments. These scenarios are designed to evaluate cooperative intelligence and generalization capabilities. The data includes natural language descriptions of game states and co-player actions.
cr:input.encodingFormat: [FILL IN THE BLANK: data format, e.g., text/csv, application/json]

cr:output.name: predictions
cr:output.description: The expected output is natural language descriptions of the agents' intended actions and interactions. These outputs should demonstrate cooperative behavior in the given scenarios.

field.name: action_description
field.description: A natural language description of the agent's intended action, e.g., 'Agent A proposes a compromise to split the resources equally.'

field.name: interaction_log
field.description: A log of interactions between agents, capturing dialogue or cooperative strategies, e.g., 'Agent B agrees to the proposal and suggests a timeline for implementation.'

cr:evaluation.primaryMetric: [FILL IN THE BLANK: primary evaluation metric]
metrics: [FILL IN THE BLANK: list of evaluation metrics]

cr:evaluation.notes: Participants will be scored based on their agents' ability to cooperate effectively in held-out scenarios. Metrics will evaluate skills such as promise-keeping, negotiation, and reciprocity.
